name: fmt
readme_excerpt: {fmt} is an open-source formatting library providing a fast and safe alternative to C stdio and C++ iostreams. Documentation Cheat Sheets Q&A: ask questions on StackOverflow with the tag fmt. Try {fmt} in Compiler Explorer. Features - Simple format API with positional arguments for localization - Implementation of C++20 std::format and C++23 std::print - Format string syntax similar to Python\'s format - Fast IEEE 754 floating-point formatter with correct rounding, shortness and round-trip guar…
